title: Are Single-Token Sparse Autoencoder Features Causally Necessary? Layer-Depth and SAE-Family Effects
abstract: arXiv:2607.20596v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sparse autoencoder (SAE) features are used to interpret and steer large language models, yet nobody has tested whether a feature's causal role is stable across SAE families. Single-token features fire on one vocabulary item, so ground truth permits direct comparison. We analyze 3.9M features across six models and three SAE families and zero-ablate at full layer depth: they sit 4.7x tighter in decoder space and concentrate in early layers. Deleting one lowers the model's logit for that token in 178 of 208 layer conditions, significant after multiple-comparison correction. And depth decides how the damage lands: early-layer deletions disrupt the layers that follow, late-layer deletions change the output directly. Cross-family causal differences exceed within-family scale effects: on the same base model, GemmaScope and BatchTopK features are causally anchored, LlamaScope features locally redundant. translated_title: 单词元稀疏自编码器特征在因果上是否必要？——层深度与SAE家族效应的影响
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征被用于解释和引导大型语言模型，但尚无人检验过某个特征的因果作用是否在不同SAE家族之间保持稳定。单词元特征仅在一个词汇项上激活，因此真值允许进行直接比较。我们分析了六个模型、三个SAE家族共390万个特征，并在全部层深度上进行零消融：这些特征在解码器空间中的分布紧密程度高出4.7倍，并集中于早期层。在208个层条件中的178个里，删除单个特征会降低模型对该词元的logit值，且在多重比较校正后依然显著。层深度决定了损害如何显现：早期层的删除会干扰其后的各层，而晚期层的删除则直接改变输出。跨家族的因果差异超过同家族内的规模效应：在同一基础模型上，GemmaScope与BatchTopK特征在因果上是锚定的，而LlamaScope特征则呈局部冗余。在LlamaScope下，该词元……
tldr: 该研究对六个模型、三个SAE家族共390万个单词元SAE特征进行全层深度零消融，首次证明单词元SAE特征在因果上确实必要，且其因果角色取决于层深度与SAE家族——早期层删除会干扰后续各层，晚期层删除直接影响输出，跨家族差异甚至超过规模效应。
en_tdlr: This study zero-ablates 3.9M single-token SAE features across six models and three SAE families, showing these features are causally necessary with causal roles shaped by layer depth and SAE family—early-layer deletions disrupt downstream layers, late-layer deletions directly alter output, and cross-family differences exceed scale effects.
